amendment: H: uncentered pattern-compressed empirical MAP sandwich with native-box-logit confidence intervals

source_reuse.purpose: Reuse only analytic marginal score and summary helpers. Failed G data/seeds are not confirmation data.

estimand: Existing PHYSICAL native MAP point estimates, unchanged. Transformed objective is ell(x(eta))+logprior(x(eta)), WITHOUT log Jacobian density.
coordinates: eta_i=logit((x_i-lo_i)/(hi_i-lo_i)) at actual native physical box bounds. Python mirt 1.2.0 c upper=.5 and d lower=.5 imply exact 0<c<d<1 for all finite 4PL eta. 3PL d remains fixed 1. No extra coupled transformation is needed for these disjoint native boxes; reject any API/bound mismatch.
method: A_x=inverse(native full joint covariance). g_x=exact marginal likelihood gradient + physical default-prior gradient. D=diag(dx/deta), h=d2x/deta2. A_eta=D A_x D-diag(g_x*h), including nonstationary chain correction. Individual transformed likelihood scores=s_x D; B_eta=sum_pattern f_pattern s_eta s_eta' UNcentered, no prior curvature in meat. C_eta=A_eta^-1 B_eta A_eta^-T. Do not require likelihood Hessian alone PD. No pseudoinverse or rescaling.
intervals: Native-box-logit eta +/- Z95 sqrt(diag(C_eta)), exact inverse mapping to physical bounds. Physical sampling SE from full D C_eta D. These are new transformed-scale frequentist candidate intervals, not Bayesian credible intervals; coverage must independently pass.
derivatives: Independent actual physical/transformed log posterior central gradients/Hessians at two steps; compressed/uncompressed score equivalence; full chain nonstationary term checked. First calibration/cell numerical Hessian vs native bread, rel Frobenius <=1e-3 and numerical Hessian step agreement <=1e-3; failures retained, never bypassed.

scope.exclusions: J30 not attempted: prior G feasibility records already show 4PL J30 exceeds bounded cost. No broad J12-J30 model certification.

precision: R300 is planned, not an automatic precision guarantee. Cluster MCSE <=.005 must actually hold; per-item coverage separately descriptive. Missing precision or incomplete campaign is INCONCLUSIVE, not certification.

budget.benchmark: Reuse identical native-fit G timings for N3000/J12 and N10000/J12; new deterministic compressed-score/unit derivative benchmark before fitting. First 10 planned replications retained for technical feasibility only; stop if estimated full cost exceeds 300 seconds. No result-based stopping or extension.

failure: Every seed/response hash, nonconvergence, Hessian mismatch, boundary/covariance refusal preserved; no retry/replacement. Failed fits included in denominator sensitivity. No unvalidated prior-score bias correction.
production: No integration/registry promotion unless all gates pass both N endpoints for a model in explicitly limited J12 scope. Original certified estimator, outputs and PR187 exports preserved. If fails, diagnose covariance calibration vs bias/asymmetry; no threshold change.
P2_P3: Only if budget remains after P1. Otherwise NOT EXECUTED; no claimed person or S-X2 certification.
